summary: At segment 0, recorded step 47 (input move index 46, space), a dart trap hits the healer. C's mthrowu.c thitu() generic-hit branch loses nonlethal damage and calls exercise(A_STR, FALSE); attrib.c exercise() then calls encumber_msg() because play has begun. The JavaScript trap_effects.js caller omits encumberMessage from thitu()'s exercise callback, so attrib.js throws before the recorded exercise call can complete. This is a caller-wiring divergence in trap.c's trapeffect_dart_trap() path.

source.branch: Hero arm (mtmp == &gy.youmonst), first DART_TRAP activation, ordinary unpoisoned dart, thitu() hit, nonlethal damage, moves > 0, and a non-polymorphed hero; the generic mthrowu.c thitu() branch reaches exercise(A_STR, FALSE).
